status: EXPERIMENTAL -- not deployed to public website, see WEBSITE policy in methodology report

simulation.cut_rule: top 60 cumulative Stableford points after R1+R2 (36 holes), ties all advance
simulation.scoring_rule: albatross +8, eagle +5, birdie +2, par 0, bogey -1, double-bogey-or-worse -3
simulation.win_tie_rule: equal win-credit split among tied co-leaders (e.g. 2-way tie = 0.5 each)
simulation.topN_tie_rule: all players tied at the Nth-place boundary score count as making TopN
simulation.course_effect: NONE -- player Stableford distribution only, no A-One course multiplier (section 12 of the operator spec)
